# Shell menus are different

File Explorer's context menu is shell-owned, and shell-owned menus ignore a synthesized Escape. In-app menus are unaffected: Notepad's File menu closes on the first escape.
**Not 'Escape is broken'.** It is specific to shell surfaces; an application's own menus still close on Escape.

| Menu | Escape |
|---|---|
| Shell context menu (Explorer) | Ignored |
| Menus inside an app | Closes |
